scope: Recorded proposal activation on captured live input only, not host execution or strength. 10 boards from 6 live Deity Religious-target games of 2026-11-09, each the run's events.jsonl cut at frame 0 of a turn where our Apostle started a fight the host's own preview priced as a losing exchange with no kill (host strength gap -3 to -13). Two further chosen boards have no 'forced' list in their summary.json and are excluded. Both arms run one frozen civvis_orders --resumed built from the branch with the run's own requested genome; the on arm adds --with theology-fights-count-the-host-edge. The off arm orders the attack this frame on 8 boards, and the on arm on 2 of them; on the other 2 boards the frame's order for the unit is a promotion in both arms. Orders differ on 6 of 10.
